title: When Is a Parole Decisionmaker Independent? A Lean 4 Study of Procedural Independence, Evidence Integrity, and Correction
description: An independent, non-peer-reviewed research preprint presenting a source-bounded Lean 4 formalization of preliminary parole-revocation decisionmaker independence, evidence integrity, and prospective correction. Federal and New York predicates remain separate. The release includes 51 audited theorems, countermodels, synthetic witnesses, negative controls, three manuscripts, source and interpretation ledgers, and reproducibility evidence. Lean verifies implications from encoded definitions and supplied premises; it does not authenticate external records or establish a judicial violation, legal cure, remedy, or outcome. Independent legal and formal-methods reviews have not been obtained. Research, formalization, code development, auditing, and drafting were human-directed and AI-assisted; Travis Darshan is responsible for scope, interpretation, and presentation.
